0.0: My father, he works at a city to make money, and therefore only stops by every once in a while. Every time he comes back, he brings a present with him for me, but... one day, he bought me a nice little doll, and a kitty ripped it up with its paws. Please help me! Help me fix this doll!

yes.0: Thank you! In order to fix the doll, I'll need #b50 #t04000106#s#k. Please help me!

no.0: I'm sorry I asked too much of you. I'm sure you're busy... if you ever find yourself a spare time, can you please help me out then...?

1.0: I've been waiting for you here!
1.1: Thank you! I think this will do in terms of fixing up my doll. Thank goodness! Here, I'll give you this. Please put it to good use!

item.0: Sniff sniff... you didn't bring enough materials for me to fix up my doll.
